name: Passport
solves: Provides unobtrusive, middleware-based authentication for Node.js with a strategy plugin model covering hundreds of OAuth/OIDC, local, JWT, and enterprise providers — letting you compose auth into Express-style apps without a monolithic framework.
best_for: Express and Connect-style Node APIs that need pluggable strategies (local, OAuth, SAML, JWT) via middleware
Legacy or greenfield Node servers that already use passport-* strategy packages in the ecosystem
Teams that want maximum control over session serialization and route-level auth hooks
APIs that authenticate with many providers via the large passport-strategy ecosystem
NestJS apps using @nestjs/passport for Guard-based authentication
skip_when: You want pre-built auth UI, user management dashboards, and hosted MFA without building them
You are on Next.js App Router and prefer Auth.js, Better Auth, or Clerk over Express middleware
You need an actively evolving TypeScript-first auth framework with modern passkey/org plugins out of the box
You prefer not to assemble session stores, strategy packages, and CSRF protection yourself
Upstream commit cadence is too slow for your risk tolerance — Passport core updates infrequently

hosted_alternative.name: Auth0
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for development; paid plans scale with monthly active users and enterprise features
